name: feature.prompts.nodes
description: Prompts feature node pack — reads over ctx.features.prompts (ADR 0116 P4): list the prompt library, get one entry, and render an entry's template with variable bindings so a workflow can compose a governed prompt. Tenant+org-guarded. role:action (recorded).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Prompts: List Library
nodes.description: Lists the org prompt library over ctx.features.prompts.listLibrary. Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { entries }.

nodes.label: Prompts: Get Entry
nodes.description: Reads one library entry over ctx.features.prompts.getEntry. Inputs: { orgId, entryId }. Output: { entry|null }.

nodes.label: Prompts: Render Entry
nodes.description: Renders an entry's referenced template with {{var}} bindings over ctx.features.prompts.renderEntry. Inputs: { orgId, entryId, variables }. Output: { composed, templateId }.
